description: A document or script parent launching an executable from the user Temp or Downloads folder matches, in both path forms; any executable in Outlook's attachment cache matches without a parent. A staging folder under a benign parent, a document parent launching an installed program, and a staging folder with an unknown parent do not.

cases.name: WINWORD.EXE spawns an executable from AppData\Local\Temp -> match
device form: WINWORD.EXE spawns an executable from AppData\Local\Temp -> match
wscript.exe spawns an executable from Downloads -> match
an executable in Outlook's attachment cache, parent unknown -> match (no parent needed)
near miss: explorer.exe spawns an executable from Downloads -> no match
near miss: WINWORD.EXE spawns an installed program -> no match
near miss: WINWORD.EXE spawns an executable from C:\Windows\Temp (not a user staging folder) -> no match
parent unresolved (ParentImage null), staging folder -> no match
